answer: A new identity starts as an isolated vertex with zero vote weight. To leave isolation it locks a copper stake sized to a week of median fees, then must complete one assigned crossing: deliver a fresh public ticket over a randomly drawn bridge linking three unconnected established clusters, each of which signs only that exact address and ticket. Weight vests only when all three signatures confirm. Clone fleets collide on the same vertex or replay a spent ticket, and the copper is slashed.
